scheme_name: Vishesh Yogyajan Sukhad Dampatya Jeevan Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a specially‑abled individual (male or female).
Applicant must possess a disability certificate showing at least 40% disability, issued by a Medical Officer or Medical Board.
Groom must be at least 21 years old and bride must be at least 18 years old.
Application must be submitted within six months of the date of marriage.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per couple is provided.
